cohort: 13,516 sibling pairs born between 1991 and 2014 at a regional tertiary medical center, where the first sibling was born vaginally and the second by cesarean delivery
finding: Cesarean delivery was independently associated with increased risk of infection-related morbidity in offspring, even after adjusting for confounders.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of bronchiolitis (OR 2.02, 95% CI 1.56-2.63), otitis media (OR 1.52, 95% CI 1.21-1.9), and gastroenteritis (OR 1.41, 95% CI 1.05-1.9) in offspring.
